quote: This very elegant bronze figure of Devi (goddess) Durga is an attractive and prominent figure and a principal deity in Hinduism.

statement.id: Durga adalah dewi penting dalam Hinduisme.
statement.en: Durga is a principal goddess in Hinduism.

quote: In Sanskrit, Durga means the inaccessible or impassable.

statement.id: Nama Durga berarti tidak terjangkau atau tidak dapat dilewati dalam Sanskerta.
statement.en: Durga means inaccessible or impassable in Sanskrit.

quote: Devi is most often manifested as the fearsome female warriors Durga and Kali, both of whom famously killed a number of terrible demons in Hindu mythology.

statement.id: Durga adalah perwujudan Devi sebagai pejuang yang mengalahkan iblis.
statement.en: Durga is a warrior manifestation of Devi who defeats demons.

quote: Devi's dark side is represented as the terrible Durga (the Inaccessible) who has ten arms, an impressive armoury of weapons, and who rides a magnificent lion or tiger.
locator: The Two Sides of Devi: Uma & Durga

statement.id: Durga digambarkan berlengan sepuluh, bersenjata, dan menunggangi singa atau harimau.
statement.en: Durga is depicted with ten arms and weapons, riding a lion or tiger.

quote: Durga slaying Mahisha (Mahishamardini) is here represented in her multi-armed form, manifesting her supreme power as the dispeller of evil, personified in the buffalo demon (asura) Mahisha, seen slumped at her feet.

statement.id: Durga mengalahkan Mahisha, iblis kerbau yang melambangkan kejahatan.
statement.en: Durga defeats Mahisha, a buffalo demon representing evil.

quote: Following the Devi Mahatmya text, she wields the mighty weapons lent to her by the assembly of male gods who singly could not defeat the demon.

statement.id: Menurut Devi Mahatmya, para dewa meminjamkan senjata kepada Durga untuk mengalahkan iblis.
statement.en: In the Devi Mahatmya, gods lend Durga weapons to defeat the demon.

quote: Durga is also worshipped in the nine-night festival Navaratri which is celebrated across India and Nepal.

statement.id: Durga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri di India dan Nepal.
statement.en: Durga is worshipped during Navaratri in India and Nepal.

quote: The festival of Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri by Hindus wherever they live.

statement.id: Dusshera dirayakan pada akhir Navaratri.
statement.en: Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri.

quote: The lion, Durga’s divine mount (vahana) on which she is shown riding majestically into battle in manuscript illustrations, is here seen emerging from behind the goddess, mauling the demon-buffalo’s hind quarters.

statement.id: Singa adalah tunggangan ilahi Durga yang tampil dalam seni pertempurannya melawan Mahisha.
statement.en: The lion is Durga's divine mount in battle imagery against Mahisha.

quote: One of Devi's most famous mythological escapades is her slaying of Mahisa, the demon who had the body of a man and the head of a buffalo, as told in the epic poem the Candipat (or Candi-mahatmya), which is part of the Skanda Purana.

statement.id: Salah satu kisah paling terkenal Devi adalah pembunuhan Mahisa, iblis bertubuh manusia berkepala kerbau, seperti dikisahkan dalam puisi epik Candipat (Candi-mahatmya), bagian dari Skanda Purana.
statement.en: One of Devi's most famous episodes is her slaying of Mahisa, a demon with a man's body and a buffalo's head, as told in the epic poem Candipat (Candi-mahatmya), part of the Skanda Purana.

quote: Swirling around heaven, this tremendous energy condensed into a single mass and formed the terrible goddess Durga. As with many Hindu tales, this is but one version of Durga's birth.

statement.id: Dalam salah satu versi, energi dahsyat para dewa menyatu menjadi satu massa dan membentuk Durga; sumber menyebut ini hanya satu versi kelahirannya.
statement.en: In one version, the tremendous energy of the gods condensed into a single mass and formed Durga; the source notes this is only one version of her birth.

quote: In other versions, Devi has already long existed as the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalaya Mountains, and in this episode she is only given weapons by the angered gods. These arms include a discus, trident, bow, sword, dagger, harpoon, and a noose

statement.id: Dalam versi lain, Devi sudah lama ada sebagai putri Himavat, dewa personifikasi Himalaya, dan para dewa yang murka hanya memberinya senjata: cakram, trisula, busur, pedang, belati, tombak, dan jerat.
statement.en: In other versions Devi has long existed as the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalayas, and the angered gods only give her weapons: a discus, trident, bow, sword, dagger, harpoon, and noose.

quote: The problem for Devi was that whenever she tried to strike Mahisa with a fatal blow he transformed into another creature - from a buffalo to a man to a lion, then to an elephant and back to a buffalo.

statement.id: Setiap kali Devi hendak menghantam Mahisa dengan pukulan mematikan, Mahisa berubah menjadi makhluk lain: kerbau, manusia, singa, gajah, lalu kerbau lagi.
statement.en: Whenever Devi tried to deliver a fatal blow, Mahisa changed into another creature: a buffalo, a man, a lion, an elephant, and then a buffalo again.

quote: At this moment, the goddess pounced and, straddling the creature, stabbed him in the neck with her trident. At this, the spirit of Mahisa came out of the mouth of the dying buffalo and Durga finally killed him by lopping off his head.

statement.id: Devi menerkam, menunggangi makhluk itu, dan menusuk lehernya dengan trisula; ketika roh Mahisa keluar dari mulut kerbau yang sekarat, Durga membunuhnya dengan memenggal kepalanya.
statement.en: The goddess pounced, straddled the creature and stabbed its neck with her trident; when Mahisa's spirit came out of the dying buffalo's mouth, Durga killed him by cutting off his head.

quote: Durga slaying Mahisa is a popular subject in Hindu art. One of the earliest representations is in a cave temple near Mallapuram dating to the 7th or 8th century CE and on the mid-8th century CE Kailasanatha temple at Ellora.

statement.id: Durga membunuh Mahisa adalah subjek populer dalam seni Hindu; salah satu penggambaran paling awal ada di kuil gua dekat Mallapuram (abad ke-7 atau ke-8 M) dan di Kuil Kailasanatha di Ellora (pertengahan abad ke-8 M).
statement.en: Durga slaying Mahisa is a popular subject in Hindu art; one of the earliest representations is in a cave temple near Mallapuram (7th or 8th century CE) and on the Kailasanatha temple at Ellora (mid-8th century CE).

quote: Devi's character has two opposing sides represented by various separate female deities: as Uma, the benevolent, and as Durga, the terrible. It is as the latter, more fierce personification that she is most frequently worshipped.

statement.id: Watak Devi punya dua sisi yang berlawanan: Uma yang lembut dan Durga yang menakutkan; sisi yang lebih garang inilah yang paling sering dipuja.
statement.en: Devi's character has two opposing sides: Uma, the benevolent, and Durga, the terrible; it is the fiercer side that is most frequently worshipped.

quote: Mahisa then revealed himself and boasted of his tremendous wealth and power so that Durga might be persuaded to marry him. Durga's somewhat dismissive response to this proposal was to transform herself into fire.

statement.id: Mahisa menyingkap dirinya dan membual tentang kekayaan serta kekuasaannya agar Durga mau menikah dengannya; Durga menanggapi lamaran itu dengan acuh dan mengubah dirinya menjadi api.
statement.en: Mahisa revealed himself and boasted of his wealth and power so that Durga would marry him; Durga responded dismissively to the proposal by transforming herself into fire.

quote: Durga is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess worshipped by indigenous mountain-dwellers of the Indian subcontinent, before being established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

statement.id: Durga dipercaya berasal dari dewi kuno yang dipuja penduduk pegunungan asli anak benua India, sebelum mapan dalam panteon utama Hindu pada abad ke-4 M.
statement.en: Durga is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess worshipped by indigenous mountain-dwellers of the Indian subcontinent, before being established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

quote: She is best known as Mahishasura-mardini; for slaying Mahishasura—the buffalo demon. In accounts of her battles with other demons such as Shumbha and Nishumbha, Durga manifests other warrior goddesses, the Matrikas, and Kali, to aid in combat.

statement.id: Durga paling dikenal sebagai Mahishasura-mardini karena membunuh Mahishasura, iblis kerbau; dalam pertempuran melawan Shumbha dan Nishumbha ia memunculkan dewi-dewi pejuang lain, yaitu para Matrika dan Kali, untuk membantunya.
statement.en: She is best known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the buffalo demon Mahishasura; in her battles with Shumbha and Nishumbha she manifests other warrior goddesses, the Matrikas and Kali, to aid her.

quote: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction, and wars; her legends center around combating evils and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

statement.id: Durga dikaitkan dengan perlindungan, kekuatan, keibuan, kehancuran, dan perang; kisahnya berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam perdamaian, dharma, dan tatanan kosmis, melambangkan kemenangan kebaikan atas kejahatan.
statement.en: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction and war; her legends center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

quote: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods of Hindu mythology, which they give her to fight the evil forces because they feel that she is shakti (energy, power). These include the chakra (divine discus), conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trishula trident, shield, mace, pink lotus flower, and noose.

statement.id: Durga secara tradisional memegang senjata berbagai dewa laki-laki yang mereka berikan agar ia melawan kejahatan karena mereka memandangnya sebagai shakti (energi, daya); di antaranya cakra, kerang, busur, anak panah, pedang, lembing, trisula, perisai, gada, bunga teratai merah muda, dan jerat.
statement.en: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods, given to her to fight evil because they regard her as shakti (energy, power); these include the discus, conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trident, shield, mace, pink lotus and noose.

quote: The word Durga (दुर्गा) literally means "impassable", "invincible, unassailable". It is related to the word Durg (दुर्ग) which means "fortress, something difficult to defeat or pass".

statement.id: Kata Durga secara harfiah berarti "tak dapat dilewati", "tak terkalahkan, tak tertembus", dan berkaitan dengan kata durg yang berarti "benteng, sesuatu yang sulit dikalahkan atau dilewati".
statement.en: The word Durga literally means "impassable", "invincible, unassailable"; it is related to durg, meaning "fortress, something difficult to defeat or pass".

quote: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidrā, the divine slumber, younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

statement.id: Dalam konteks Waisnawa, Durga dihormati sebagai Yoganidra, tidur ilahi, adik perempuan sekaligus versi perempuan Wisnu.
statement.en: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidra, the divine slumber, younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

quote: Vishnu offers Durga the task of transferring the seventh child of Devaki into the womb of Rohini, as well as being born on earth as the infant daughter of Yashoda and Nanda, so that she could be swapped with Krishna.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi Waisnawa, Wisnu menugaskan Durga memindahkan anak ketujuh Devaki ke rahim Rohini dan lahir sebagai bayi perempuan Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.
statement.en: In Vaishnava tradition, Vishnu gives Durga the task of moving Devaki's seventh child into Rohini's womb and of being born as the infant daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so she could be swapped with Krishna.

quote: There are many epithets for Durga in Shaktism and her nine appellations are (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

statement.id: Dalam Shaktisme Durga punya banyak julukan, dan sembilan sebutannya (Navadurga) adalah Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, dan Siddhidatri.
statement.en: In Shaktism Durga has many epithets, and her nine appellations (Navadurga) are Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

quote: In the north wall of a granite cave in Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu there is a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630–674 CE.

statement.id: Di dinding utara sebuah gua granit di Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, terdapat relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura yang diukir sekitar 630-674 M.
statement.en: On the north wall of a granite cave in Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, there is a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630-674 CE.

quote: The 6th-century CE inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script, such as at the Nagarjuni hill cave during the Maukhari era, already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura

statement.id: Prasasti abad ke-6 M beraksara Siddhamatrika awal, misalnya di gua bukit Nagarjuni pada masa Maukhari, sudah menyebut kisah kemenangannya atas Mahishasura.
statement.en: Sixth-century CE inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script, such as at the Nagarjuni hill cave in the Maukhari era, already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura.

quote: Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established by the time the classic Hindu text called Devi Mahatmya was composed, which scholars variously estimate to between 400 and 600 CE.

statement.id: Durga sebagai dewi pembunuh iblis kemungkinan sudah mapan ketika teks klasik Devi Mahatmya disusun, yang oleh para sarjana diperkirakan antara 400 dan 600 M.
statement.en: Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established when the classic text Devi Mahatmya was composed, which scholars variously date to between 400 and 600 CE.

quote: Her iconography typically resonates with these attributes, where she rides a lion or a tiger, has between eight and eighteen hands, each holding a weapon to destroy and create.

statement.id: Ikonografinya biasanya menampilkan Durga menunggangi singa atau harimau dengan delapan sampai delapan belas tangan yang masing-masing memegang senjata.
statement.en: Her iconography typically shows her riding a lion or a tiger, with between eight and eighteen hands, each holding a weapon.

quote: Durga iconography has been flexible in the Hindu traditions, where for example some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implements in her hand since they consider their stylus as their weapon.

statement.id: Ikonografi Durga lentur dalam tradisi Hindu; misalnya sebagian cendekiawan meletakkan pena atau alat tulis di tangannya karena menganggap penanya sebagai senjata.
statement.en: Durga iconography has been flexible in Hindu traditions; for example some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implement in her hand because they consider their stylus their weapon.

quote: Himavan, the personification of the Himalayas, gifted a lion as her mount.

statement.id: Dalam kisah ini, Himavan, personifikasi Himalaya, menghadiahkan seekor singa sebagai tunggangannya.
statement.en: In this account Himavan, the personification of the Himalayas, gifted a lion as her mount.

quote: Durga has a significant following all over Nepal, India, Bangladesh and many other countries.

statement.id: Durga memiliki banyak pengikut di seluruh Nepal, India, Bangladesh, dan banyak negara lain.
statement.en: Durga has a significant following all over Nepal, India, Bangladesh and many other countries.

quote: Durga is typically portrayed as a celibate warrior goddess. However, at a certain point in her history, she becomes associated with the god Śiva as his wife.

statement.id: Durga umumnya digambarkan sebagai dewi pejuang yang selibat, tetapi pada suatu titik dalam sejarahnya ia dikaitkan dengan Dewa Siwa sebagai istrinya.
statement.en: Durga is typically portrayed as a celibate warrior goddess, but at a certain point in her history she becomes associated with the god Shiva as his wife.

quote: Durgā is a very popular deity. The name is indifferently applied to all goddesses with a terrible appearance and in a fighting attitude.

statement.id: Durga adalah dewi yang sangat populer; nama itu dipakai tanpa pembedaan untuk semua dewi berwujud menakutkan dan bersikap bertempur.
statement.en: Durga is a very popular deity; the name is applied indifferently to all goddesses with a terrible appearance and in a fighting attitude.

quote: The Saivāgama specifically describes nine varieties of Durgā, all of which have two arms but different weapons

statement.id: Saivagama secara khusus menguraikan sembilan ragam Durga, semuanya bertangan dua tetapi bersenjata berbeda.
statement.en: The Saivagama specifically describes nine varieties of Durga, all with two arms but different weapons.

quote: In this role, Durgā assumes domestic characteristics and is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

statement.id: Dalam peran sebagai istri Siwa, Durga mengambil sifat rumah tangga dan sering diidentifikasi dengan dewi Parwati.
statement.en: In this role as Shiva's wife, Durga assumes domestic characteristics and is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

quote: The general description of Durgā given in the Kāsyapa-Silpa represents her as having four arms, two eyes

statement.id: Uraian umum tentang Durga dalam Kasyapa-Silpa menggambarkannya berlengan empat dan bermata dua.
statement.en: The general description of Durga in the Kasyapa-Silpa shows her with four arms and two eyes.

quote: From Mahābalipuram comes the figure of a Durgā (fig. 124) who stands on the buffalo's head. She has eight arms, in the uppermost of which are found the discus and the conch.

statement.id: Sebuah arca Durga dari Mahabalipuram berdiri di atas kepala kerbau dan berlengan delapan; di tangan teratasnya terdapat cakram dan kerang.
statement.en: A figure of Durga from Mahabalipuram stands on the buffalo's head and has eight arms; the discus and the conch are in the uppermost ones.

quote: Durga is commonly known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the half-buffalo demon Mahishasura. She is also known as Vindhyavasini (she who dwells in the Vindhya Mountains).

statement.id: Durga lazim disebut Mahishasura-mardini karena membunuh iblis setengah kerbau Mahishasura, dan juga dikenal sebagai Vindhyavasini (ia yang tinggal di Pegunungan Vindhya).
statement.en: Durga is commonly known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the half-buffalo demon Mahishasura, and also as Vindhyavasini (she who dwells in the Vindhya Mountains).

quote: Durga is also known as Durgati Nashini, meaning one who eliminates suffering.

statement.id: Durga juga dikenal sebagai Durgati Nashini, yang berarti ia yang melenyapkan penderitaan.
statement.en: Durga is also known as Durgati Nashini, meaning one who eliminates suffering.

quote: Doing rather well, Mahisa managed to kick most of the gods out of heaven, forcing them to wander the earth as mere men.

statement.id: Mahisa berhasil mengusir sebagian besar dewa dari surga sehingga mereka berkelana di bumi sebagai manusia biasa.
statement.en: Mahisa managed to drive most of the gods out of heaven, forcing them to wander the earth as mere men.
